hook.goal: Create an emotional connection with the stuffed dog — notice its soft fur, floppy ears, and cozy appearance
hook.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, personal feeling hook, invitational tone

transition.goal: Invite the child to imagine what the dog is thinking and feeling in different scenarios — introduce the what_would_it_say game
transition.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, explain game simply, end with genuine invitation (Would you like to try?)

rounds.goal: Explore how the dog feels about warm sunshine on its belly
Explore how the dog reacts to an unexpected bump or trip
Explore how the dog reacts when its favorite treat arrives

celebrate.goal: Celebrate the child as an Emotion Translator — they heard the dog feeling happy, surprised, and excited; connect to IB concept Perspective
celebrate.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, name 1 IB concept naturally

closing.goal: Leave the child with a cross-session hook — next time they see their fluffy friend, try imagining what it's thinking
closing.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, warm and gentle

early_exit.goal: Gentle goodbye that validates whatever they did — they are a great friend to the dog
early_exit.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, no pressure to continue
